vonage:index:AccountSettings.description: The default SMS webhooks of the Vonage account (POST /account/settings). A singleton: there is exactly one per account, so create adopts it, import ID is the account API key, and destroy clears only the URLs this resource manages. Vonage requests each URL and rejects it unless it answers 200.

drCallBackUrl.description: Default webhook URL for SMS delivery receipts (dr = delivery receipt). Vonage requests the URL and only saves it when it answers 200. When unset the resource does not manage it, and removing it from a program that managed it clears the URL on the account.

maxCallsPerSecond.description: Maximum API calls per second Vonage allows the account. Read-only.

maxInboundRequest.description: Maximum inbound SMS requests per second Vonage allows the account. Read-only.

maxOutboundRequest.description: Maximum outbound SMS requests per second Vonage allows the account. Read-only.

moCallBackUrl.description: Default webhook URL for inbound SMS (mo = mobile originated). Vonage requests the URL and only saves it when it answers 200. When unset the resource does not manage it, and removing it from a program that managed it clears the URL on the account.

drCallBackUrl.description: Default webhook URL for SMS delivery receipts (dr = delivery receipt). Vonage requests the URL and only saves it when it answers 200. When unset the resource does not manage it, and removing it from a program that managed it clears the URL on the account.

vonage:index:ApiSecret.description: An API secret for a Vonage account or subaccount. An account can have at most two secrets; Vonage refuses to revoke the last remaining one.

accountKey.description: API key of the account that owns the secret. Defaults to the provider's account; set it to a subaccount's apiKey to rotate that subaccount's secrets. Changing it replaces the resource.

ownerKey.description: The account API key that owns the secret.

secret.description: The secret value (8-25 characters with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter and one digit). Vonage never returns it again, so it is kept in state as a secret. Changing it replaces the resource: when the account already holds two secrets the old one is revoked first, otherwise the new one is created first.

accountKey.description: API key of the account that owns the secret. Defaults to the provider's account; set it to a subaccount's apiKey to rotate that subaccount's secrets. Changing it replaces the resource.

vonage:index:Application.description: A Vonage application (Application API v2): capabilities, webhooks and signing keys. Update replaces the whole configuration, so every capability you want must be declared in the program; video and networkApis you do not declare are preserved as they are on the server, and removing a block you declared earlier disables that capability.

applicationId.description: The Vonage application ID (UUID). Use it as app_id for numbers and as the JWT application_id claim.

applicationPublicKey.description: The PEM public key registered with the application.

improveAi.description: Whether Vonage may use traffic to improve its AI models (privacy.improve_ai).

meetings.description: Meetings capability. Omit to leave meetings disabled.

messages.description: Messages capability. Omit to leave messages disabled.

name.description: Application name (shown in the Vonage dashboard).

networkApis.description: Network APIs capability (SIM Swap, Number Verification). Omit to leave it as it is on the server.

privateKey.description: The PEM private key generated by Vonage. Vonage returns it exactly once, on creation, and never again; it is stored as a secret in Pulumi state. Unset when publicKey was supplied.

publicKey.description: Optional PEM public key. When omitted Vonage generates a key pair on creation and the private key is returned once as privateKey. When set, no private key is generated.

rtc.description: RTC capability. Omit to leave RTC disabled.

vbc.description: Set true to enable the (empty) vbc capability for zero-rated VBC calls.

verify.description: Verify v2 capability. Omit to leave verify disabled.

video.description: Video API capability: webhooks and recording storage. Omit to leave video as it is on the server; an existing video capability configured outside Pulumi is preserved until you declare the block.

voice.description: Voice capability. Omit to leave voice disabled.

vonage:index:ExternalAccountApplicationL.description: Links a Vonage application to a Messenger, Viber Service Message or WhatsApp account (one application per account). The ID is channel/externalId/applicationId. Removing the resource unlinks the application and never deletes the account or the application. Shapes follow the published specification and were not verified against a live account.

channel.description: The account's channel: messenger, viber_service_msg or whatsapp. Changing it replaces the link.

externalId.description: The account's external ID: the Facebook Page ID, the Viber Service Message ID or the WhatsApp number. Changing it replaces the link.

vonage:index:MessengerAccount.description: A Facebook Messenger page registered with Vonage (beta External Accounts API). Link an application with ExternalAccountApplicationLink. Shapes follow the published specification and were not verified against a live account.

accessToken.description: The Facebook Page access token. Secret. Changing it rotates the token in place.

apiKey.description: The api_key Vonage reports for the account.

applications.description: IDs of the applications linked to the account (at most one). Output only; link one with ExternalAccountApplicationLink.

externalId.description: The Facebook Page ID. Also the resource ID. Changing it replaces the account.

name.description: A custom name for the account. When unset, the name Vonage holds (if any) is left alone and is not a diff.

vonage:index:NetworkApplicationProfile.description: A Vonage Network Registry application profile. Registering one is a submission that mobile operators review, so its status moves from pending towards accepted on its own. The API has no update call, so changing any input replaces the profile: the new one is created first, then the old one is deleted (Vonage deletes softly), and each account may hold at most 50 profiles. Shapes follow the published Network Registry OpenAPI definition and were not verified against a live account.

accountId.description: ID of the Vonage account that owns the profile.

businessProfileId.description: ID of the NetworkBusinessProfile that owns this application profile. Changing it replaces the profile.

categoryId.description: Category of the application, from getNetworkRegistryCatalogue categories (for example finance). Changing it replaces the profile.

description.description: Description of the application's use cases (at most 1000 characters). Optional fields left unset are not managed. Changing it replaces the profile.

infrastructureLocations.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 codes of the countries the application's infrastructure runs in. Changing them replaces the profile.

name.description: Name of the application (at most 100 characters). Changing it replaces the profile.

networkApis.description: The Network APIs the application uses and the purposes it states for each. Changing them replaces the profile.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: URL of the application's privacy policy (at most 500 characters). Changing it replaces the profile.

termsAndConditionsAccepted.description: Whether you accept the Network Registry terms and conditions (see getNetworkTermsAndConditions). Sent only when set. Changing it replaces the profile.

vonage:index:NetworkApplicationProfileSh.description: Shares a Network Registry application profile with another Vonage account. The resource ID is PROFILE_ID/ACCOUNT_ID. Vonage accepts the share asynchronously (HTTP 202), so a refresh right after creation may briefly not list it. Shapes follow the published Network Registry OpenAPI definition and were not verified against a live account.

accountId.description: ID (API key) of the Vonage account to share the profile with. Changing it replaces the share.

profileId.description: ID of the application profile to share, which your account must own. Changing it replaces the share.

accountId.description: ID (API key) of the Vonage account to share the profile with. Changing it replaces the share.

vonage:index:NetworkBusinessProfile.description: A Vonage Network Registry business profile. Registering a profile is a legal submission that Vonage and mobile operators review: it is not an instant API call, and its status moves from pending towards accepted on its own. Vonage has no plain update: a changed input is submitted as a change request, which the profile reflects once approved (until then the resource reports the requested values). Destroying the resource deletes the profile (Vonage deletes softly and can undelete it). Shapes follow the published Network Registry OpenAPI definition and were not verified against a live account.

changeRequestStatus.description: Status of the latest change request (pending, accepted or rejected), when there is one.

contactRole.description: Role of the person responsible for the profile, for example CTO (at most 100 characters).

countries.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 codes of the countries the business will use Network APIs in. They decide which operators (CSPs) and vetting levels apply; see getNetworkRegistryCatalogue.

dpoEmail.description: Email address of the data protection officer.

dpoRequired.description: Whether the business is required to have a data protection officer.

vonage:index:Number.description: A Vonage virtual number. Buying is billed; cancelling is permanent. Both are explicit inputs (acquisition, cancelOnDelete).

acquisition.description: How the number joins the account: "buy" purchases it (BILLED, fails if the account already owns it) or "adopt" manages a number the account already owns (fails if it does not). Only used when the resource is created; later changes are ignored (no diff, no replace), because replacing a number would cancel it.

appId.description: Application ID the number is linked to. Mutually exclusive with moHttpUrl and voiceCallbackType/Value.

cancelOnDelete.description: Required explicit choice. true: destroying this resource CANCELS (permanently releases) the number. false: destroying it only removes it from Pulumi state; the number stays on the account and keeps billing.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the number, for example US. Changing it replaces the resource.

effectiveVoiceCallbackType.description: Voice routing type Vonage currently applies (sip, tel or app).

effectiveVoiceCallbackValue.description: Voice routing target Vonage currently applies.

features.description: Capabilities of the number, for example SMS, VOICE, MMS.

messagesCallbackType.description: Effective inbound messages routing type (app or empty).

messagesCallbackValue.description: Effective inbound messages routing target (usually the linked application ID).

moHttpUrl.description: Webhook for inbound SMS when the number is not linked to an application.

msisdn.description: The number in international format without a leading plus, for example 14155550100. Changing it replaces the resource.

type.description: Number type reported by Vonage, for example landline, mobile-lvn or landline-toll-free.

voiceCallbackType.description: Voice routing type when the number is not linked to an application: sip, tel or app.

voiceCallbackValue.description: Voice routing target: a SIP URI, a phone number or an application ID, matching voiceCallbackType.

voiceStatusCallback.description: Webhook that receives voice call status events for the number.

vonage:index:NumberPool.description: A Vonage number pool. Add numbers with NumberPoolNumber. Shapes follow the published Number Pools API specification and were not verified against a live account.

accountId.description: ID of the account that owns the pool (the API key).

fallback.description: What Vonage does when no number in the pool can send the message: Pool (use any pool number), "CustomFrom" (use the sender in the request) or Reject (fail the message).

localizedSenderPreferred.description: Prefer a pool number local to the destination country when one exists. Defaults to false when unset (Vonage requires the flag on create, so false is sent).

poolId.description: Your identifier for the pool, unique within the account. Also the resource ID. Changing it replaces the pool.

predictableSenderPreferred.description: Keep using the same pool number for the same recipient when possible. Defaults to false when unset (Vonage requires the flag on create, so false is sent).

poolId.description: Your identifier for the pool, unique within the account. Also the resource ID. Changing it replaces the pool.

predictableSenderPreferred.description: Keep using the same pool number for the same recipient when possible. Defaults to false when unset (Vonage requires the flag on create, so false is sent).

vonage:index:NumberPoolNumber.description: Membership of one owned number in a Vonage number pool. The ID is poolId/number. Removing the resource removes the number from the pool and never releases the number itself.

number.description: The owned number in E.164 format without the leading plus (7-15 digits). Changing it replaces the membership.

poolId.description: ID of the pool to add the number to. Changing it replaces the membership.

number.description: The owned number in E.164 format without the leading plus (7-15 digits). Changing it replaces the membership.

poolId.description: ID of the pool to add the number to. Changing it replaces the membership.

vonage:index:SubAccount.description: A Vonage subaccount under the primary account. Subaccounts cannot be deleted through the API, only suspended (see suspendOnDelete). Requires primary account credentials.

apiKey.description: The subaccount API key (also the resource ID).

generatedSecret.description: The subaccount API secret as returned by Vonage at creation. Stored as a secret.

primaryAccountApiKey.description: API key of the primary account that owns this subaccount.

secret.description: API secret for the subaccount, set at creation only (8-25 characters with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter and one digit). When omitted Vonage generates one, exposed as the generatedSecret output. Create-only: the Vonage API cannot change it on an existing subaccount, so later changes are ignored (no diff, no update); manage rotation with the ApiSecret resource.

suspendOnDelete.description: Vonage cannot delete subaccounts. When true, destroying this resource suspends the subaccount; when false or unset it is only removed from Pulumi state and stays active.

usePrimaryAccountBalance.description: Whether the subaccount draws on the primary account balance (server default true).

secret.description: API secret for the subaccount, set at creation only (8-25 characters with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter and one digit). When omitted Vonage generates one, exposed as the generatedSecret output. Create-only: the Vonage API cannot change it on an existing subaccount, so later changes are ignored (no diff, no update); manage rotation with the ApiSecret resource.

suspendOnDelete.description: Vonage cannot delete subaccounts. When true, destroying this resource suspends the subaccount; when false or unset it is only removed from Pulumi state and stays active.

usePrimaryAccountBalance.description: Whether the subaccount draws on the primary account balance (server default true).

vonage:index:User.description: A Vonage Users API user (USR-<uuid>), scoped to the application whose applicationId and privateKey the provider is configured with. Authenticates with an application JWT signed from the private key, so it needs only applicationId and privateKey, not apiKey and apiSecret. The resource ID is the user ID. Shapes follow the published Users API and were not verified against a live account.

channels.description: The channels the user can be reached on. Each list is replaced as a whole on update.

customData.description: Free-form JSON object stored on the user (properties.custom_data).

imageUrl.description: URL of an image for the user.

name.description: Unique name of the user within the application. When omitted Vonage generates one (NAM-<uuid>), which is recorded in state but is not a difference. Changing an explicit name replaces the user, because the API's update call is not documented to rename.

channels.description: The channels the user can be reached on. Each list is replaced as a whole on update.

customData.description: Free-form JSON object stored on the user (properties.custom_data).

imageUrl.description: URL of an image for the user.

name.description: Unique name of the user within the application. When omitted Vonage generates one (NAM-<uuid>), which is recorded in state but is not a difference. Changing an explicit name replaces the user, because the API's update call is not documented to rename.

vonage:index:VerifyTemplate.description: A Verify v2 template. Import with the template ID.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the account's default template for Verify requests that name none (server default false). Making another template the default un-defaults this one outside Pulumi, which shows as drift.

templateId.description: The Vonage-assigned template ID (also the resource ID).

isDefault.description: Whether this is the account's default template for Verify requests that name none (server default false). Making another template the default un-defaults this one outside Pulumi, which shows as drift.

vonage:index:VerifyTemplateFragment.description: The text of a Verify v2 template for one channel and locale. Import with templateId/templateFragmentId.

channel.description: Delivery channel: sms or voice. Changing it replaces the fragment.

locale.description: Locale of the text, for example en-us. Changing it replaces the fragment.

templateFragmentId.description: The Vonage-assigned fragment ID. The resource ID is templateId/templateFragmentId.

templateId.description: ID of the VerifyTemplate this fragment belongs to. Changing it replaces the fragment.

text.description: The message text, including Vonage placeholders such as ${code}. Updated in place.

channel.description: Delivery channel: sms or voice. Changing it replaces the fragment.

locale.description: Locale of the text, for example en-us. Changing it replaces the fragment.

templateId.description: ID of the VerifyTemplate this fragment belongs to. Changing it replaces the fragment.

text.description: The message text, including Vonage placeholders such as ${code}. Updated in place.

vonage:index:getAccountBalance.description: Read the balance of the provider's Vonage account (GET /account/get-balance).

autoReload.description: Whether auto-reload is enabled on the account.

vonage:index:getAccountSettings.description: Read the default SMS webhooks and rate limits of the provider's Vonage account. Vonage has no GET for these, so this sends POST /account/settings with no fields, which returns the current values unchanged.

drCallBackUrl.description: Default SMS delivery receipt webhook URL, empty when none is set.

maxInboundRequest.description: Maximum inbound SMS requests per second.

maxOutboundRequest.description: Maximum outbound SMS requests per second.

moCallBackUrl.description: Default inbound SMS webhook URL, empty when none is set.

vonage:index:getApiSecret.description: Look up an API secret's metadata by account and secret ID. Vonage never returns the secret value. Fails if it does not exist.

accountKey.description: API key of the owning account. Defaults to the provider's account.

ownerKey.description: The account API key that owns the secret.

vonage:index:getApiSecrets.description: List the API secrets (IDs and creation times) of an account.

accountKey.description: API key of the account. Defaults to the provider's account.

ownerKey.description: The account API key that was listed.

vonage:index:getApplication.description: Look up a Vonage application by ID or exact name.

applicationId.description: Application ID (UUID). Exactly one of applicationId or name must be set.

name.description: Exact application name. Fails if zero or more than one application matches.

capabilities.description: Enabled capabilities, sorted: messages, meetings, rtc, vbc, verify, voice.

meetings.description: The meetings capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

messages.description: The messages capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

networkApis.description: The network_apis capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

publicKey.description: PEM public key registered with the application.

rtc.description: The rtc capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

vbc.description: True when the vbc capability is enabled; unset otherwise.

verify.description: The verify capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

video.description: The video capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

voice.description: The voice capability as configured on the application, or unset when it is not enabled.

vonage:index:getApplications.description: List the account's Vonage applications, optionally filtered by exact name.

name.description: Only return applications with exactly this name.

vonage:index:getAvailableNumbers.description: Search the numbers available to buy in a country (GET /number/search). Read-only: it never buys a number, and a Number resource still has to.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example US.

features.description: Capabilities the number must have: SMS, VOICE and MMS.

pattern.description: Digit pattern the number must match.

searchPattern.description: How pattern matches: 0 starts with, 1 contains (the default), 2 ends with.

type.description: Number type: landline, mobile-lvn or landline-toll-free.

count.description: Total number of matches Vonage reports (all pages).

numbers.description: The numbers on the requested page.

vonage:index:getExternalAccount.description: Look up a Messenger, Viber Service Message or WhatsApp account registered with Vonage by channel and external ID. Fails if it does not exist.

channel.description: The account's channel: messenger, viber_service_msg or whatsapp.

externalId.description: The account's external ID: the Facebook Page ID, the Viber Service Message ID or the WhatsApp number.

accessToken.description: The Facebook Page access token. Secret. Set only for a Messenger account.

apiKey.description: The api_key Vonage reports for the account.

applications.description: IDs of the linked applications (at most one).

name.description: The account name (empty when none is set).

vonage:index:getExternalAccountApplicati.description: Check whether an application is linked to an external account. Fails if the account does not exist.

applicationId.description: The application ID to look for.

channel.description: The account's channel: messenger, viber_service_msg or whatsapp.

applicationId.description: The application ID that was looked for.

linked.description: Whether the application is linked to the account.

vonage:index:getExternalAccounts.description: List the external (Messenger, Viber Service Message, WhatsApp, RCS) accounts registered with Vonage, following every page.

channel.description: Only list accounts of this channel: messenger, viber_service_msg, whatsapp or rcs. Defaults to every channel.

accounts.description: Every matching account, across all pages.

vonage:index:getMessengerAccount.description: Look up a Messenger account registered with Vonage by Facebook Page ID, including its page access token (secret). Fails if it does not exist.

accessToken.description: The Facebook Page access token. Secret. Set only for a Messenger account.

apiKey.description: The api_key Vonage reports for the account.

applications.description: IDs of the linked applications (at most one).

name.description: The account name (empty when none is set).

vonage:index:getNetworkApplicationProfil.description: Look up a Network Registry application profile by ID. A deleted profile is reported as not found.

accountId.description: ID of the Vonage account that owns it.

businessProfileId.description: ID of the business profile that owns it.

description.description: Description of the application's use cases; empty when unset.

infrastructureLocations.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 codes of the countries the application's infrastructure runs in.

networkApis.description: The Network APIs the application uses and the purposes it states for each.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: URL of the application's privacy policy; empty when unset.

status.description: Overall approval status: pending, provisioning, accepted, partially-accepted, rejected or failed.

statusMessage.description: Vonage's note about why the profile was rejected; empty when there is none.

updatedAt.description: When the profile was last updated (RFC 3339).

vonage:index:getNetworkApplicationProfil.description: Look up whether a Network Registry application profile is shared with an account. The API has no get-one call, so this lists the profile's shares and picks the match; an absent share is reported as not found.

accountId.description: ID (API key) of the Vonage account the profile is shared with.

profileId.description: ID of the application profile, which your account must own.

accountId.description: ID of the Vonage account the profile is shared with.

vonage:index:getNetworkApplicationProfil.description: List the Vonage accounts a Network Registry application profile has been shared with, following every page.

profileId.description: ID of the application profile, which your account must own.

accountIds.description: IDs of the Vonage accounts the profile is shared with.

vonage:index:getNetworkApplicationProfil.description: List the account's Network Registry application profiles, following every page.

businessProfileId.description: Only list the profiles of this business profile.

shared.description: List the profiles other accounts have shared with this one instead of the account's own. Defaults to false.

status.description: Only list profiles with this overall status (pending, provisioning, accepted, partially-accepted, rejected or failed).

profiles.description: The application profiles, deleted ones excluded.

vonage:index:getNetworkBusinessProfile.description: Look up a Network Registry business profile by ID. Fails if it does not exist or has been deleted.

accountId.description: ID of the account that owns the profile.

countries.description: Countries the profile is registered for.

statusMessage.description: Vonage's note about the status, empty when there is none.

vonage:index:getNetworkBusinessProfiles.description: List the account's Network Registry business profiles, following every page.

shared.description: List the profiles other accounts have shared with this one instead of the account's own. Defaults to false.

profiles.description: The business profiles, deleted ones excluded.

vonage:index:getNetworkRegistryCatalogue.description: Read the Network Registry reference data (countries, organisation types, categories, CSPs, Network APIs, purposes, vetting levels and terms and conditions), following every page. Read-only and free.

all.description: List every CSP and Network API defined on the platform, not only the ones enabled for the account. Defaults to false.

countries.description: Only list the CSPs and Network APIs available in these two-letter ISO 3166 country codes.
Countries a business profile can be registered for.

networkApis.description: Network APIs and the callback URLs each requires.

organisationTypes.description: Valid organisationType values of a business profile.

purposes.description: Purposes Network APIs can be used for.

termsAndConditions.description: Terms and conditions documents; read the text with getNetworkTermsAndConditions.

vettingLevels.description: Vetting levels and the extra fields each needs.

vonage:index:getNetworkTermsAndCondition.description: Read one Network Registry terms and conditions document by ID. Fails if it does not exist.

documentId.description: ID of the document, as listed in getNetworkRegistryCatalogue termsAndConditions.

vonage:index:getNumber.description: Look up a number owned by the account. Fails if the account does not own it.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example US.

msisdn.description: The number in international format without a leading plus.

appId.description: Linked application ID, empty if none.

moHttpUrl.description: Inbound SMS webhook, empty if none.

vonage:index:getNumberPool.description: Look up a number pool by ID. Fails if it does not exist.

fallback.description: Fallback behaviour: Pool, CustomFrom or Reject.

localizedSenderPreferred.description: Whether a number local to the destination is preferred.

predictableSenderPreferred.description: Whether the same number is reused for the same recipient.

vonage:index:getNumberPoolNumber.description: Check that a number is in a pool. Fails if the pool does not exist or the number is not in it.

number.description: The number to look for, 7-15 digits with no leading plus.
The number, which is in the pool.

vonage:index:getNumberPoolNumbers.description: List the numbers in a pool, following every page. Fails if the pool does not exist.

numbers.description: Numbers in the pool, in E.164 format without the leading plus.

vonage:index:getNumberPools.description: List the account's number pools, following every page.

pools.description: Every number pool of the account.

vonage:index:getNumbers.description: List the numbers owned by the account (GET /account/numbers), following every page.

applicationId.description: Only numbers linked to this application ID.

country.description: Only numbers in this two-letter ISO country code, for example US.

hasApplication.description: Only numbers that are (true) or are not (false) linked to an application.

pattern.description: Only numbers matching this digit pattern.

searchPattern.description: How pattern matches: 0 starts with, 1 contains (the default), 2 ends with.

numbers.description: The matching numbers, in the order Vonage lists them.

vonage:index:getPricing.description: Read Vonage's outbound price list for SMS, SMS transit or voice, for one country (GET /account/get-pricing/outbound), for a dialling prefix (GET /account/get-prefix-pricing/outbound) or for every country (GET /account/get-full-pricing/outbound). Read-only. Prices are decimal strings in the account currency.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example GB. Cannot be combined with prefix. With neither country nor prefix every country is returned.

prefix.description: International dialling prefix, digits only, for example 44. Cannot be combined with country.

serviceType.description: The service to price: sms, sms-transit or voice. Defaults to sms.

countries.description: The price lists. One entry for a country lookup, one per matching country otherwise.

vonage:index:getSubAccount.description: Look up a subaccount of the provider's primary account by API key. Fails if it does not exist.

balance.description: Subaccount balance, unset when it uses the primary balance.

creditLimit.description: Subaccount credit limit, unset when it uses the primary balance.

primaryAccountApiKey.description: API key of the owning primary account.

usePrimaryAccountBalance.description: Whether the subaccount draws on the primary account balance.

vonage:index:getSubAccounts.description: List the subaccounts of the provider's primary account, optionally filtered by exact name.

name.description: Only subaccounts with exactly this name.

primaryAccountApiKey.description: API key of the primary account (the provider's own key).

vonage:index:getUser.description: Look up a user of the configured application by ID or exact name. Needs applicationId and privateKey. Fails if the user does not exist.

name.description: Exact name of the user. Exactly one of userId and name is required.

userId.description: ID of the user (USR-<uuid>). Exactly one of userId and name is required.

channels.description: The user's channels, if any (SIP passwords are not returned by the API).

customData.description: The user's custom data object, if any.

vonage:index:getUsers.description: List the users of the configured application, following every page. Needs applicationId and privateKey.

name.description: Only return the user with exactly this name.

users.description: The users of the application. Use getUser for channels and custom data.

vonage:index:getVerifyTemplate.description: Look up a Verify v2 template by ID or exact name.

name.description: Exact template name. Fails if zero or more than one template matches.

templateId.description: Template ID. Exactly one of templateId or name must be set.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the account's default template.

vonage:index:getVerifyTemplateFragment.description: Look up a Verify v2 template fragment by fragment ID, or by channel and locale.

channel.description: Channel (sms or voice), used with locale.

templateFragmentId.description: Fragment ID. Set this, or both channel and locale.

templateId.description: The template the fragment belongs to.
